open_questions: FY2026 (ended 2026-08-30, d209) has no Director Compensation table yet: Costco files its proxy in early December, so the 2026 proxy (expected about December 2026) will carry it, including Gina M. Raimondo's first row (elected 2026-01-15).

Charles T. Munger's FY2024 row shows the full $37,000 retainer and the full October 2023 RSU grant even though he died on 2023-11-28 (d154), about 12 weeks into the fiscal year. The 2024 proxy gives no footnote, while Foulkes's footnote (d164) implies fees are paid quarterly; whether the retainer was paid in advance or to his estate is not disclosed.

W. Craig Jelinek's FY2024 non-employee director fees ($18,500 'from April 2024', d165) appear only in the Summary Compensation Table's All Other Compensation footnote, because he was an NEO (employee until April 2024, d166). No FY2024 director_comp row is recorded for him; his FY2024 equity was the 27,129-share officer RSU grant (d167), and the 2024 proxy does not mention any director RSU grant to him that year.
Values of the RSUs that vested on Munger's death (d155) and of the free Costco executive membership given to directors (d162) are not disclosed; neither appears in the table.

coverage.method: Director Compensation tables from every definitive proxy filed 2019 through 2026-10-13: DEF 14A 2019-12-10 (FY2019), 2020-12-10 (FY2020), 2021-12-10 (FY2021), 2022-12-06 (FY2022), 2023-12-07 (FY2023), 2024-12-11 (FY2024) and 2025-12-04 (FY2025); no 2026 proxy has been filed yet (Costco files in December). 60 rows (8, 9, 8, 8, 9, 9, 9). Every table has only Fees Earned or Paid in Cash, Stock Awards and Total columns; the other columns are recorded as 0, dashes as 0, and every row's cash + stock equals its printed total. Employee directors (Jelinek and Galanti while employed, Vachris) are never in the table; Jelinek's FY2024 director fees sit in the Summary Compensation Table (d165) and are not recorded. Checked with no director table: every DEFA14A 2019-2025 (the 'additional' notice filings, plus 0001193125-22-008659). The 2019-11-29 PRE 14A prints a director section identical to the DEF 14A and is not recorded. No 10-K/A was filed. Fiscal years use Costco's numbering (52/53 weeks ending the Sunday nearest the end of August); fiscal_year_ends comes from the 10-K covers (d201-d209).
